csv_project_name: Planning for Milwaukie Stanley SAFE Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Milwaukie May be Seeking a Consultant to Provide a Planning Service for Grind and Inlay Stanley Ave between King Rd and Johnson Creek Blvd, construct continuous sidewalk and landscape strip on one side of roadway, upgrade ramps to ADA compliance, install crosswalks, install RRFB at Logus Rd crossing, and add box culvert at Johnson Creek crossing for pedestrian access Construct overflow piping from 2 existing UIC's (1 at Hill St. and 1 at Willow St.) to discharge point in Ball-Michel Park. Includes: 285 feet of 12-inch stormwater pipe, 88 feet of 18-inch stormwater pipe. 1 G-2 inlet, 3 SD Manhole, 1 18-inch Slope End Projection, and 2 connections to existing structures.

title: Planning for Milwaukie Stanley SAFE Improvements
short_description: Street safety and drainage improvements with sidewalks, crossings, ADA ramps, and stormwater works.

Stormwater works include 285 ft of 12-inch pipe, 88 ft of 18-inch pipe, 1 G-2 inlet, 3 storm drain manholes, 1 18-inch slope end projection, and 2 connections to existing structures.
services: Planning services; landscape architecture; civil engineering; geotechnical engineering; planning/master planning; traffic design engineering.

- Project type aligns more with roadway/public realm improvements, which are of limited relevance to sbp.
